action_description: ONE grounded vertical chop: 37.5% raise into a brief shoulder-back charge; 37.5% a fast high-to-low cut and decelerating follow-through; final 25% recover. Rear foot planted; lead foot lunges then returns.
locked_constraints: exactly one attack total: one wind-up, strike/contact, follow-through, recovery
after contact: no wind-up/swing; no repeat, second hit, combo, or loop
vertical chop only; no horizontal slash, thrust, spin, or projectile
charge only: blade behind shoulder; same grip/shape
